rule.name: PairSplitDropsRest
rule.message: This reads the second part of a String.split on ":" or "=", so a value that contains the separator (a URL, a message, a base64 =) loses everything after it, and a text without the separator throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException. Split once with a limit: text.split(":", 2) and check the length, or cut at text.indexOf(":"). A format that cannot hold the separator twice takes an exceptions entry.

property.name: xpath
